column1: # Choral (aufx Ni$I -NI-) per-mode first voice pair, measured with an impulse train (one -6 dBFS click every 50 ms, 48 kHz, 8 s).
# setup:   export RE_STATE=<shared state>; export RE=<repo>/tools/re; T=$RE_STATE/work/chorus/tools; cd $RE_STATE/work/chorus/bb
#          param 0 Mode: 0 Synth, 0.3333 Ensemble, 0.6667 Dimension, 1 Universal; 1 Voices=1.00; 6 Width=100% (voice 1 -> L, voice 2 -> R); 7 Mix=100%; Rate 0.25 Hz, Amount 50% = plugin defaults
# analyse: python3 $T/cx.py trk <wav> --ch <0|1> --short      strongest wet tap per click; cents = 1200*log2(1 - d(delay)/dt); crest: sine 1.41, triangle 1.73, square 1.0

# Voices=3.00 (render with --set 1=1, files ch_m<mode>_v1.wav): wet taps in delay order, python3 $T/cx.py trk <wav> --ch 0 --k <0|1|2> --thr -14 --short  (tracks swap when taps cross, so only min delay and count are reliable)
# L/R phase of the first pair (same renders): python3 $T/cx.py lr ch_m<mode>_v0.wav
